name: runJob
description: I run a job immediately, right now, regardless of its schedule. I find the job, execute its action, record the result, and return. This doesn't affect the scheduled runs. I use this when I want to test a job or when the user needs results right now.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: I need the exact job name I used when I created it, or the UUID I returned from createJob. I try the name first, then the UUID. Either one works.
